title: Cheng et al. benched slope, global minimum

meta.title: Cheng et al. benched slope, global minimum
meta.notes: Homogeneous benched slope; the global minimum on the mid-lower face by circular search.

source.reference: Cheng, Y.M., Lansivaara, T. & Wei, W.B. (2007). Two-dimensional slope stability analysis by limit equilibrium and strength reduction methods. Computers and Geotechnics 34(3), 137–150.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V020 (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: commercial program E shear strength reduction 1.35.

Geometry from Cheng et al.'s Fig. 13a (read at 400 dpi): every corner falls on whole meters, (0, 10), (10, 10), (20, 15), (26, 20), (32, 20), (35, 23), (43, 27), (55, 27), base 0; until 2026-10-25 the model used a digitisation 0.06–0.2 m off them. Cheng et al.'s limit-equilibrium global minimum is 1.33 (p. 146, Fig. 13a, simulated-annealing search over general surfaces); 1.327 is their strength-reduction value, which the check carried before. Local minima 1.375, 1.415, 1.40, 1.383 (docs/kallor/cheng-lansivaara-wei-2007.md).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
